decisions.decision: Qualify installed Launcher UE5.8.2 before any upgrade
decisions.reason: Existing installation and Cargo compatibility reduce initial friction
decisions.revisit: Pinned-engine blocker or proven upgrade benefit with rollback

decisions.decision: Git LFS locally first; private remote only after binary/storage forecast
decisions.reason: Solo code workflow, existing tools, no required service spend
decisions.revisit: Multi-artist locking pain or measured storage/transfer cost

decisions.decision: Two modules, runtime and editor; no large gameplay framework by default
decisions.reason: Own narrow contracts and avoid integration overhead
decisions.revisit: Framework qualification proves net time saved for central mechanic

decisions.decision: One active gameplay change, parallel isolated research/review
decisions.reason: Protect binary assets and integration attention
decisions.revisit: Measured independent streams and adequate hardware

decisions.decision: Free selective asset intake before paid basket
decisions.reason: Budget below EUR500 and limited RAM/storage
decisions.revisit: Documented missing capability with favorable total integration cost

decisions.decision: Local builds/tests; hosted self-runner template inactive
decisions.reason: Keep machine access and recurring costs explicit
decisions.revisit: Need remote unattended dispatch and runner isolation is ready

decisions.decision: Authored city/orbit sectors and persistent contracts
decisions.reason: Preserve core fantasy within solo scope

decisions.decision: AI assists production; no runtime generative backend
decisions.reason: Offline game, deterministic saves, asset rights and controlled scope
decisions.revisit: Specific funded design need with cost, safety and rights review

decisions.decision: Brass Sanctuary art direction with Indigo Monsoon rain and night reference
decisions.reason: Explicit user approval on 2026-10-12; original moth guardian and material palette tie the city to rented daylight
decisions.revisit: Only after user review of the representative in-game block

decisions.decision: Plan at least 4000 accepted geometric assets through a 4200-brief hybrid library
decisions.reason: User requested a comprehensive worldbuilding and modular asset strategy; planned records are distinct from accepted models
decisions.revisit: Measured content needs and exemplar throughput; merge redundant designs without counting recolors or LODs

decisions.decision: Keep AI-restricted kits in artistic and technical comparisons and record their published terms separately
decisions.reason: Explicit user direction on 2026-10-13; shortlist inclusion does not change vendor terms
decisions.revisit: Actual acquisition terms and operation-specific processing decision

decisions.decision: Author loose props for carrying, throwing and collection; stage later destruction
decisions.reason: User approved staged local destruction followed by selected structural destruction on 2026-10-13; broader collapse remains research. Stable identity, complete geometry and component boundaries are cheaper to establish before large-scale dressing
decisions.revisit: After ten-object persistence proof and a bounded breakage prototype

decisions.decision: Complete existing city prop integration, then author the full canonical living planet before construction or additional mechanics
decisions.reason: Explicit user redirection on 2026-10-13 and newly created active goal. Requires deep lore, coherent mapped regions/cities, ecology, cultures, weather, exploration, people, events and asset production requirements. The Development mechanics handoff passed 20 smoke tests and 57 rendered checks.
decisions.revisit: After the complete bible, atlas and lore have passed coherence review; earlier bounded-release proposals do not limit this world-authoring scope

decisions.decision: Adopt Nacre/Rauth/Ilex and edition 0.1 as the working planet frame, with explicit physical assumptions and draft boundaries
decisions.reason: Authorial decisions under the user's full-world goal preserve the moon setting, real day/night and Orison while establishing a 5900 km world, a checked orbital candidate, 742 AL chronology and geographic concept. These are working canon decisions, not additional claimed user approvals or a constructed planet.
decisions.revisit: Coupled physical/climate review, detailed regional authoring and full-bible coherence review; preserve stable IDs and record changes
